title: SCI-FI LEGENDS: The Ultimate Sci-Fi Trivia Night
shortDescription: Explore legendary science fiction worlds at Charter 803, with trivia, prizes, and a special tribute to Sir Patrick Stewart.
description:
We’re changing things up at Charter 803!

Following the passing of Sir Patrick Stewart, Four Dogs Entertainment is dedicating Thursday’s trivia night to the legendary worlds, characters, and adventures of science fiction.

From Star Trek and Star Wars to Back to the Future, Jurassic Park, Doctor Who, X-Men, The X-Files, and more, we’re putting your sci-fi knowledge to the test!

We’ll also feature a special tribute celebrating Patrick Stewart’s incredible legacy as Captain Jean-Luc Picard and Professor X.

Join Joey at Charter 803 on Thursday, November 5, at 6:30 PM. Assemble your crew, bring your best team name, and compete for prizes!

Message Charter 803 to reserve your table.

Bring your people. We’ll bring the Doggone Good Time.
instructions: Message Charter 803 directly to reserve your table. Free admission; food and drinks are purchased separately.
